categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen FRD Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, design, production, and sales of electromagnetic shielding materials and devices, thermal management materials and devices, base station antennas and related components, protective functional devices, lightweight materials and devices, and functional components. The company provides comprehensive solutions in these fields, serving industries such as network communications, data centers, servers, consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, artificial intelligence, photovoltaic energy storage, medical equipment, and household appliances.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary technologies including carbon fiber metallization, conductive silicone formulations, multi-color porous co-extrusion, and advanced manufacturing processes for thermal and electromagnetic shielding materials. Key production methods include precision die-cutting, stamping, injection molding, high-performance liquid cooling modules, and semi-solid casting for lightweight aluminum alloy components. The company also emphasizes R&D in high thermal conductivity graphite, micro-pump liquid cooling, phase change energy storage materials, and high-performance 3D vapor chamber (VC) heat dissipation modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span major global and domestic enterprises in telecommunications (Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, Ericsson, Cisco), consumer electronics (Microsoft, Lenovo, Samsung, Xiaomi, HP, Dell), data centers and servers (Huawei, Inspur, Cisco, Lenovo), new energy vehicles (BYD, GAC, BAIC, CATL, Geely), photovoltaic and energy storage (Huawei, GoodWe, Growatt), and other sectors including medical devices, robotics, and household appliances. The company serves markets driven by 5G, AI, cloud computing, new energy, and intelligent manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Shenzhen, Changzhou, Dongguan, Foshan, Kunshan, Zhuhai, and overseas production in Vietnam. It has sales and service offices in major Chinese cities like Beijing and Shanghai, and overseas sales points in the USA (San Jose), Finland (Helsinki), Japan, and South Korea. The company is expanding its international footprint, focusing on Southeast Asia and emerging markets to diversify export markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen FRD operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and solution provider of advanced materials and components for electromagnetic shielding, thermal management, and related electronic device parts. It collaborates closely with upstream raw material suppliers and downstream OEMs and system integrators in electronics, telecommunications, automotive, and energy sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in electromagnetic shielding and thermal management technologies, focusing on liquid cooling, high-performance graphite materials, flexible VC, micro-pump liquid cooling, and advanced composite materials for lightweight applications. It invests in R&D collaborations with top universities and research institutes, aiming to enhance product performance, reduce costs, and expand applications in AI servers, 5G base stations, new energy vehicles, and emerging fields like robotics and low-altitude economy. The company also emphasizes green manufacturing and sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products including electromagnetic shielding materials, thermal management devices, base station antennas, protective components, lightweight materials, and functional modules. The company also provides integrated application solutions and technical services to its customers. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and acceptance of goods or services, with a focus on product sales rather than subscription or licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in the electromagnetic shielding and thermal management materials sector in China, recognized for its comprehensive product lines and technological capabilities. It competes with other manufacturers in the electronic materials and components industry, particularly in high-tech fields such as 5G communications, AI computing, and new energy vehicles. Its competitive advantages include proprietary technologies, broad product portfolio, strong customer relationships, and global delivery capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.03 billion, representing a 15.76% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 189 million, an 83.01% increase year-over-year. The company’s total assets reached approximately RMB 7.86 billion, with steady growth in revenue and profitability. R&D investment accounted for over 5% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation. The company’s market share and production capacity have been expanding, supported by ongoing investments in new projects and facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shenzhen FRD emphasizes its ability to provide comprehensive, customized electromagnetic shielding and thermal management solutions with high reliability, advanced technology, and broad product variety. Its products offer superior performance in heat dissipation, electromagnetic interference shielding, and lightweight design, meeting the stringent requirements of cutting-edge applications such as AI servers, 5G infrastructure, new energy vehicles, and medical devices. The company’s integrated R&D, manufacturing flexibility, global delivery network, and close customer collaboration differentiate it in the market, enabling cost-effective and innovative solutions tailored to diverse customer needs.
